'''Gareth Walters''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 GenCon UK Sunday tournament]] on 5 September 1999 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT and IAO with Drazin]], according to Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d52">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-26-gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-dated52/ gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-date], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 26 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-26-gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-dated52/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
